id: \bYou think you stand a chance?
en: \bYou think you stand a chance?

id: \bBy just a kid.
en: \bBy just a kid.

id: \bN: \PN, thank you for stopping Team Plasma. You've shown me that Pokémon and people can be partners rather than master and servant.
en: \bN: \PN, thank you for stopping Team Plasma. You've shown me that Pokémon and people can be partners rather than master and servant.
it: \bN: \PN, grazie per aver fermato il Team Plasma. Mi hai dimostrato che Pokémon e persone possono essere compagni, anziché padrone e servo.

id: \bNot today.
en: \bNot today.

id: \bTeam Plasma will win.
en: \bTeam Plasma will win.

id: \rWe are justice.
en: \rWe are justice.

id: \rWe should be unstoppable.
en: \rWe should be unstoppable.

id: \bWe are too strong for you to stop us.
en: \bWe are too strong for you to stop us.
it: \bSiamo troppo forti perché tu possa fermarci.

id: \bHow strong are you?
en: \bHow strong are you?

id: \bColress himself is going to change the world.
en: \bColress himself is going to change the world.

id: \bThis is not part of the plan.
en: \bThis is not part of the plan.

id: \bColress: Oh, someone actually came to stop me.
en: \bColress: Oh, someone actually came to stop me.
it: \bAcromio: Oh, qualcuno è venuto davvero a fermarmi.

id: \bMy name is Colress. I'm here on Team Plasma's behalf to capture this Pokémon. I suppose you also have the same idea.
en: \bMy name is Colress. I'm here on Team Plasma's behalf to capture this Pokémon. I suppose you also have the same idea.
it: \bMi chiamo Acromio. Sono qui per conto del Team Plasma per catturare questo Pokémon. Suppongo che anche tu abbia la stessa idea.

id: \bHow about I battle you for it? With my mind controlling device I'm able to bring out a Pokémon's true strength. I'll never lose to you.
en: \bHow about I battle you for it? With my mind controlling device I'm able to bring out a Pokémon's true strength. I'll never lose to you.
it: \bChe ne dici se ce lo contendiamo in una lotta? Con il mio dispositivo di controllo mentale posso tirare fuori la vera forza di un Pokémon. Non perderò mai contro di te.

id: \bColress: I can't believe I lost. I'll let you have this for now, but don't think this is the last of me.
en: \bColress: I can't believe I lost. I'll let you have this for now, but don't think this is the last of me.
it: \bAcromio: Non posso credere di aver perso. Per ora te lo lascio, ma non pensare di esserti liberato di me.

id: \bNot so fast.
en: \bNot so fast.

id: \bLooker: It is I, Looker of the International Police. You're all under arrest.
en: \bLooker: It is I, Looker of the International Police.  You're all under arrest.
it: \bBellocchio: Sono io, Bellocchio della Polizia Internazionale.  Siete tutti in arresto.

id: \b\PN, thank you for your assistance once again. Another group of criminals have been brought to justice.
en: \b\PN, thank you for your assistance once again.  Another group of criminals have been brought to justice.
it: \b\PN, grazie ancora una volta per il tuo aiuto.  Un'altra banda di criminali è stata assicurata alla giustizia.

id: \bWhat?
en: \bWhat?

id: \bYou got lucky.
en: \bYou got lucky.

id: \bDon't bother yourself with me.
en: \bDon't bother yourself with me.

id: \bLooker: Thank you for your help. I'll deal with rounding up the rest of Team Plasma.
en: \bLooker: Thank you for your help. I'll deal with rounding up the rest of Team Plasma.
it: \bBellocchio: Grazie per il tuo aiuto. Mi occuperò io di radunare il resto del Team Plasma.
